content.definition: money in the form of notes and coins, rather than cards or cheques
content.example: If you wish to pay cash, present your staff ID at the cashier's office.
content.exampleCn: 如果要付现金，请在收银处出示员工证件。
content.meaningDetailZh: G类阅读通知和缴费说明中常表示现金付款，和信用卡、工资代扣相对。

content.definition: used to introduce a different person or topic
content.example: As for speed, even those animals that cover long distances do not need special training.
content.exampleCn: 至于速度，即使那些跑长距离的动物也不需要特殊训练。
content.meaningDetailZh: 用来另起话题，把注意力转到某人或某事上。G类阅读里常见于段落开头，相当于 speaking of / regarding。不要和 as well as for 混淆。

content.definition: a large tree that produces acorns, or the hard wood from this tree
content.example: The cabin furniture is made of oak and can withstand heavy use.
content.exampleCn: 小屋家具由橡木制成，可以承受频繁使用。
content.meaningDetailZh: G类阅读里可指橡树或橡木材质。本批短文里也作为姓氏 Oaks 出现，学习卡按普通名词“橡树/橡木”处理。

content.definition: quickly or at a fast rate
content.example: Plans for new wind farms are proceeding apace in an effort to meet the renewable-energy target.
content.exampleCn: 为了达到可再生能源目标，新风电场的规划正在迅速推进。
content.meaningDetailZh: G类阅读说明文里常修饰项目、建设或变化的推进速度，相当于 rapidly。

content.definition: the grey powder left after something burns, including volcanic ash
content.example: Scrolls at Herculaneum were protected by ash from the catastrophic eruption of Mount Vesuvius.
content.exampleCn: 赫库兰尼姆的卷轴被维苏威火山灾难性喷发形成的火山灰保护了下来。
content.meaningDetailZh: G类阅读历史和灾难叙述中常指燃烧后的灰或火山灰；复数 ashes 也可指废墟。

content.definition: to become worse in quality, strength or behaviour
content.example: If we do not train, we quickly degenerate into couch potatoes.
content.exampleCn: 如果我们不训练，很快就会退化成整天坐着的人。
content.meaningDetailZh: G类阅读科普文章中常表示身体能力、习惯或状态变差；也可作形容词表示退化的。

content.definition: the act of spending more money than is necessary, or something expensive and unnecessary
content.example: Today, conspicuous extravagance no longer seems desirable among consumers.
content.exampleCn: 如今，招摇的奢侈在消费者中似乎不再受欢迎。
content.meaningDetailZh: G类阅读讨论消费和环保时，常表示过度花费或铺张，和 recycling、节约相对。

content.definition: a very hard stone that can produce sparks when struck against iron
content.example: The device consisted of a flint which struck against a piece of iron when a handle was turned.
content.exampleCn: 这个装置有一块燧石，摇动手柄时它会撞击铁片。
content.meaningDetailZh: G类阅读科技史或采矿安全文章中指用来打火的硬石头。

content.definition: to go somewhere you cannot be seen, or to put something where it cannot be found
content.example: Children can hide among the large fungi while solving puzzles along the way.
content.exampleCn: 孩子们可以躲在大型真菌之间，一边解谜一边前进。
content.meaningDetailZh: G类阅读活动介绍中常作动词，表示躲起来或不让人看见；名词“兽皮”不是这批短文里的主要用法。

content.definition: a brand of credit or debit card used to pay for goods and services
content.example: Tickets can be reserved by phone and paid for by Visa, MasterCard or Amex.
content.exampleCn: 可以电话预订门票，并用 Visa、万事达或美国运通卡付款。
content.meaningDetailZh: G类阅读广告和票务材料中常出现，表示一种可刷卡支付的信用卡品牌，常与 Visa、Amex 并列。

content.definition: a ship that can travel under water; also used to describe things under the sea
content.example: He said being inside the enclosed space felt a bit like being in a box or a submarine under water.
content.exampleCn: 他说待在那个封闭空间里，有点像待在箱子里或水下的潜水艇中。
content.meaningDetailZh: G类阅读里可指潜水艇，也可作比喻，形容封闭、隔绝空气的空间。

content.definition: protected by law or firmly established as a right or interest
content.example: They have a vested interest in ensuring that their mother's offspring reach adulthood.
content.exampleCn: 他们在确保母亲的后代长大成人这件事上有既得利益。
content.meaningDetailZh: G类阅读里最常见搭配是 vested interest，表示与自身利益相关、因而希望某事成功。

content.definition: in a way that makes it seem that something is true or happening
content.example: Just as it seemed as though Deliwe was about to take the pencil with her trunk, Hendrick called her back.
content.exampleCn: 就在德利韦好像要用鼻子拿走铅笔的时候，亨德里克把她叫了回来。
content.meaningDetailZh: 引导看起来如此、但不一定属实的情况，和 as if 同义。G类阅读叙述动作或场面时常用。

content.definition: in order to help, protect, or achieve something
content.example: Notices such as these are put up for the sake of audience safety.
content.exampleCn: 张贴这类告示是为了观众的安全。
content.meaningDetailZh: 表示为了某人的利益或某个目的而做某事。G类阅读通知和说明文里常接 safety、convenience、health 等。

content.definition: the place where fighting happens in a war, or the most advanced or exposed position in an activity
content.example: They are at the front line of a relentless wave of technologically driven change in communication.
content.exampleCn: 他们处在通信领域一波持续技术变革的最前线。
content.meaningDetailZh: 原指战场前线，G类阅读里也常比喻最先面对变化、压力或服务的位置，如 front-line staff。

content.definition: supporting a person, plan, or idea; preferring one thing instead of another
content.example: After hearing overwhelming arguments in favour of the project, the Secretary of War agreed.
content.exampleCn: 在听到压倒性的支持该项目的理由后，陆军部长同意了。
content.meaningDetailZh: 表示站在某方案或某一方一边。G类阅读讨论政策、工程或选择时常见；美式拼写是 in favor of。

content.definition: a board on a wall where notices and messages are displayed
content.example: Don't forget to check out our notice board for cheap cars and travel deals.
content.exampleCn: 别忘了看看我们的布告栏，上面有便宜车辆和旅行优惠。
content.meaningDetailZh: G类阅读住宿、校园和营地材料中指张贴通知、广告或转让信息的公告板。美式说法是 bulletin board。

content.definition: a place or position in a team or activity; also used to say that something is exactly right
content.example: She caught Frankland's eye and was offered a job at the factory, as well as a spot on the team.
content.exampleCn: 她引起了弗兰克兰的注意，得到了工厂的工作，还获得了队里的一个名额。
content.meaningDetailZh: 这批 Part 3 原文里是 a spot on the team，表示队中的一个位置或名额。口语里 spot-on 也可单独表示“完全正确、非常准确”。
